notes: TITLE WITHHELD: the published title 'Whos your mom that right MYO is; DPC S-H-I-T' is a spelled-out swear word plus a 'your mom' joke.

The list is posted in crude joke names (kept verbatim as posted). Section headers ('Starting crap7', 'location3', 'beatdown squad21', 'blue @#$%3', 'red stuff26') are not cards; total 60 as published.

Starting cards as posted under 'Starting crap7': My Kind Of Scum / Fearless And Inventive (posted 'MKOS'), Tatooine: Jabba's Palace (posted 'TatJP'), Tatooine: Desert Heart, Prepared Defenses, There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement, Power Of The Hutt; these count toward the 60. Several Effects start, so no single starting Effect is set.

Posted 'do or do not & opp enforcement' (Do, Or Do Not is a Light card) dested the Dark combo There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement; 'blast the door' (Blast The Door, Kid! is a Light card) dested the Dark Effect Blast Door Controls.

Posted 'jpnew site' dested Jabba's Palace: Lower Passages (the new Jabba's Palace site of the Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck); 'sail barge crappy site' Jabba's Sail Barge: Passenger Deck; 'jabba's cadillac' Jabba's Sail Barge.

Posted 'ig w bazooka', '4lom w crack pipe', 'bob w buterfly net', 'dengar w superlaser' dested IG-88 With Riot Gun, 4-LOM With Concussion Rifle, Boba Fett With Blaster Rifle, Dengar With Blaster Carbine; 'gay-lid' Gailid; 'mighty pimp jabba' Mighty Jabba; 'your mom, myo' Myo; 'bib' Bib Fortuna; 'elephant man' Ephant Mon; 'chall bacon' Chall Bekan; 'suckass in boat'/'bossk in boat' Zuckuss In Mist Hunter / Bossk In Hound's Tooth.

Posted 'control & set for @#$%' dested Control & Set For Stun; 'jabba throw with your mom' Jabba's Through With You; 'gayyyy & those sissy wont escape us' Ghhhk & Those Rebels Won't Escape Us; 'no wuss shall pass' None Shall Pass; 'imp barier' Imperial Barrier; 'projective telepaty' Projective Telepathy.

Posted 'cum & spaghetti x2' matches no card with confidence (perhaps Scum And Villainy, but that card is unique); kept as UNKNOWN as posted. Posted 'grabbler x3' is UNKNOWN as in his post 18147 (several Dark cards fit 'Grabber').

The post names the event only as 'the DPC'; dated 1 March 2001, before the Vegas DPC, it is taken to be the first DPC, held in Normal, Illinois. His Light list posted on 27 February 2001 (14076, 'Why leia is in her week DPC S-H-I-T') is the other half.
